output.reason: The only evidence is a one-line PR title [ev-cd857bf3470c]. It says Crossplane may now merge existing MRDs from provider MRDs, but not what the merge changes, which fields it touches or what an operator would notice. The rest of the section shows MRDs were introduced in this same release ([ev-47653e3e1ebb], [ev-543a22471270], [ev-2c984df9c0e9]). So it is unclear whether an environment upgrading to 2.0.0 could even have existing MRDs, and "none" is as plausible as behavior-change. The proposed statement that provider definitions can modify existing MRDs is an inference the evidence doesn't support. Deciding this needs the PR description or upgrade-guide text explaining what merging does to MRDs that already exist.
